              LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN x →
                LT.lt.{0} x (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) → Eq.{1} (m₁ x) (m x)) →
            And (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)))
                (And
                  (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)) 3)
                    (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
                  (And (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)))
                    (And
                      (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)) 3)
                        (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
                      (And
                        (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
                          (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)) 2)))
                        (And
                          (LE.le.{0}
                            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)) 2))
                                1)
                              (m (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1)) 2))))
                            (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
                          (And
                            (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
                              (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)) 2)))
                            (LE.le.{0}
                              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                                  (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)) 2)) 1)
                                (m (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)) 2))))
                              (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)))))))) →
              Eq.{1}
                (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.appVal m₁ (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1))
                  (m₁ (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)))
                (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.appVal m (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 1))
                  (m (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.G_ 2)))

source.code:
theorem appVal_stable {m m₁ : Mem} (hG1 : m₁ (G_ 1) = m (G_ 1)) (hG2 : m₁ (G_ 2) = m (G_ 2))
    (hO : m₁ (OUT_ 0) = m (OUT_ 0)) (harr : arrAt m₁ (m (OUT_ 0)) = arrAt m (m (OUT_ 0)))
    (hheap : ∀ x, IN ≤ x → x < m HP → m₁ x = m x)
    (hb : IN ≤ m (G_ 1) ∧ m (G_ 1) + 3 ≤ m HP ∧ IN ≤ m (G_ 2) ∧ m (G_ 2) + 3 ≤ m HP ∧
      IN ≤ m (m (G_ 1) + 2) ∧ m (m (G_ 1) + 2) + 1 + m (m (m (G_ 1) + 2)) ≤ m HP ∧
      IN ≤ m (m (G_ 2) + 2) ∧ m (m (G_ 2) + 2) + 1 + m (m (m (G_ 2) + 2)) ≤ m HP) :
    appVal m₁ (m₁ (G_ 1)) (m₁ (G_ 2)) = appVal m (m (G_ 1)) (m (G_ 2)) := by
  rw [hG1, hG2]; exact appVal_stable' hO harr hheap hb
